title: Venice: The Threshold Across the Lagoon
summary: Follow the Ponte della Libertà causeway over the shimmering Venetian Lagoon into Piazzale Roma, where road travel ends and Venice’s labyrinth of canals begins.

fields.director_notes: Prompt: Adapt pixel-city-drive to capture the historic 8.35 km drive across Ponte della Libertà into Venice. MiniMax M3.1 Flash role: Directed camera speed, lighting transition from golden afternoon across the open lagoon into lit dusk at Piazzale Roma, landmark framing, and voiceover timing. Visuals: Pixel art rendering of 143 OpenStreetMap building footprints, lagoon waters, and historic church domes. Audio: MiniMax Speech 2.8 HD English narration synchronized to milestone vistas.
fields.my_city_line: Where asphalt surrenders to water: Venice.
